tokens.name: tw-brand
tokens.usage: The identity grey of the avatar and the favicon. Fixed across themes: it is the mark, not a UI colour. Never use it for text.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-900
tokens.usage: Darkest step of the ramp. The dark theme's page ground.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-850
tokens.usage: The dark theme's card and panel surface.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-800
tokens.usage: The dark theme's raised surface, one step above a card.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-750
tokens.usage: Ramp step between the raised surface and the control ground.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-700
tokens.usage: The dark theme's control ground: buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-650
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers on a dark ground.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-500
tokens.usage: The midpoint, identical to the brand grey. The whole ramp is anchored here so the mark and the interface share one family.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-300
tokens.usage: Muted text on a dark ground.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-200
tokens.usage: The light theme's control ground, and hairlines on a light ground.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-100
tokens.usage: The light theme's raised surface.

tokens.name: tw-neutral-050
tokens.usage: The light theme's card and panel surface.

tokens.name: tw-bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Every contrast figure in this system is measured against this or against tw-surface.

tokens.name: tw-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and the nav bar: one step off the page ground.

tokens.name: tw-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and anything that sits above a card.

tokens.name: tw-control-bg
tokens.usage: The ground under buttons, inputs and chips. Pair it with tw-control-text, never with tw-accent.

tokens.name: tw-control-text
tokens.usage: Foreground on tw-control-bg: 5.11:1 dark, 4.95:1 light. Controls get their own foreground because tw-accent only reaches 3.79:1 on the control ground.

tokens.name: tw-text
tokens.usage: Body text on tw-bg: 5.67:1 dark, 5.78:1 light. The brand blue, darkened for the light theme.

tokens.name: tw-text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text. Dark is 3.93:1, so on a dark ground use it at 24px or above only; light is 7.09:1 and unrestricted.

tokens.name: tw-text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and labels that must recede without disappearing.

tokens.name: tw-accent
tokens.usage: The burnt orange, on the page ground only: 5.22:1 dark, 5.64:1 light. On a control ground use tw-control-text.

tokens.name: tw-accent-hover
tokens.usage: The accent under pointer or focus: 7.01:1 dark, 4.52:1 light.

tokens.name: tw-link
tokens.usage: Inline links on the page ground: 7.04:1 dark, 5.64:1 light.

tokens.name: tw-success
tokens.usage: A completed or valid state. Always pair it with a word or an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: tw-warn
tokens.usage: A caution that does not block the reader.

tokens.name: tw-danger
tokens.usage: A failure or a destructive action. Pair it with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: tw-glass-bg
tokens.usage: The translucent ground of the frosted nav bar, used together with tw-glass-blur.

tokens.name: tw-space-1
tokens.usage: The base step. Gaps inside a control, between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: tw-space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside compact controls; the gap between related items in a row.

tokens.name: tw-space-3
tokens.usage: The gap between navigation links, and padding in medium controls.

tokens.name: tw-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page's side gutter.

tokens.name: tw-space-6
tokens.usage: The gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: tw-space-8
tokens.usage: The gap between sections.

tokens.name: tw-space-10
tokens.usage: The largest step: the space around a page's main region.

tokens.name: tw-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags and other small surfaces.

tokens.name: tw-radius-md
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, inputs and cards.

tokens.name: tw-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and large panels.

tokens.name: tw-radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and pills.

tokens.name: tw-weight-light
tokens.usage: Display text only. One of the three weights with a shipped font face.

tokens.name: tw-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body copy and everything unemphasised.

tokens.name: tw-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Headings, buttons and labels. The heaviest face that ships; never ask for 600 or 700.

tokens.name: tw-leading-tight
tokens.usage: Headings and display text. Unitless, so it scales with the size it lands on.

tokens.name: tw-leading-normal
tokens.usage: Interface text: labels, buttons, table cells.

tokens.name: tw-leading-loose
tokens.usage: Long-form prose at 18px.

tokens.name: tw-glass-blur
tokens.usage: The backdrop-filter radius of the frosted nav bar: backdrop-filter: blur(var(--tw-glass-blur)). A blur radius, not a spacing step, so it is not on the 4px grid.
